svg.title: Agentic vs contextual chunking comparison
svg.desc: Two side-by-side approaches: contextual chunking enriches existing chunks with LLM-generated context; agentic chunking uses an LLM to decide boundaries from scratch.

g.text: Enrich existing chunks with LLM context

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the initial chunking step work in contextual chunking?')
sendPrompt('What prompt does contextual chunking use to generate context sentences?')
sendPrompt('How is the context prepended to a chunk before embedding?')
sendPrompt('What does a contextually enriched chunk look like?')
sendPrompt('How does an LLM determine chunk boundaries in agentic chunking?')
sendPrompt('What structured output format does agentic chunking return?')
sendPrompt('How are agentic chunk boundaries applied to produce the final chunks?')
sendPrompt('What use cases justify the cost of agentic chunking?')
